title: 9 thoughts on “What Is A Character Questionnaire? The Only Character Questionnaire You Need”
use_cases: Use when developing multidimensional characters for fiction
Configure when adapting character templates to include social and biological nuances
Implement when auditing character arcs for inclusivity and depth
Use when organizing creative writing workshops or curricula
content:
1. ![](https://www.writerswrite.co.za/the-character-questionnaire-you-need-to-complete)
Loved this ?
Thank you
2. ![](https://www.writerswrite.co.za/the-character-questionnaire-you-need-to-complete)
Thank you, Atoosa.
3. ![](https://www.writerswrite.co.za/the-character-questionnaire-you-need-to-complete)
I appreciate that unlike a lot of character questionnaires this one does address sexuality. I would suggest one small change, if I may? After Birth – #4 perceived biological sex of the child does not relate to their gender. Does the character agree with their birth gender assignment? This can have minor to major impact on them from the time they are toddlers until adulthood depending on how they identify and how supportive their caregivers are to them.
Thank you for compiling such a great list of insightful questions.
4. ![](https://www.writerswrite.co.za/the-character-questionnaire-you-need-to-complete)
Thank you for the suggestion, Davonne. It is certainly something to consider in future posts and questionnaires.
5. ![](https://www.writerswrite.co.za/the-character-questionnaire-you-need-to-complete)
Dear Amanda,
My name is Ana Ruiz, I am a retired elementary and
ESL teacher. I am 69 and I live in Costa Rica. I have followed
you posts for a few years now. It is impossible for
me to attend your workshops in Johannesburg, but
would it be possible for you or any other of your facilitators
to come down to Costa Rica. I belong
of creative writing workshop and there is plenty
of people here interested in writing.
We will have to think in cost, accommodations, price and
place. I will take care of all details concerning the organization.
Please let me know if you are interested.
Maybe it is not such a crazy idea.
Regards,
Ana
6. ![](https://www.writerswrite.co.za/the-character-questionnaire-you-need-to-complete)
Although I have a character template that I use, I am always looking for ways to improve it. This has a lot of excellent questions. Thank you.
7. ![](https://www.writerswrite.co.za/the-character-questionnaire-you-need-to-complete)
Absolutely brilliant list, thank you
8. ![](https://www.writerswrite.co.za/the-character-questionnaire-you-need-to-complete)
please send me this to my email inbox – very interesting.
9. ![](https://www.writerswrite.co.za/the-character-questionnaire-you-need-to-complete)
